license.name: Restroom Stalls and All (RSA)
license.registry: Alabama Licensing Board for General Contractors, License Roster (licensesearch.alabama.gov/genconbd, full roster CSV)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The full Alabama GC Board roster CSV has no entry with 'Restroom', 'Stalls' or 'RSA' in the name, none matching the company phone (844) 817-8255, and none of the Gainesville, GA licensees is this company. Alabama requires this license only for commercial jobs of $100,000 or more (genconbd.alabama.gov), so most partition installs don't need it. Birmingham's city business license for contractors has no public online lookup that we checked. The company site (restroomstallsandall.com) gives its base as Gainesville, GA, phone 1-844-817-8255, and says it 'installs them with our own crews across the Southeast' (GA, FL, AL, TN, SC, NC). It lists no contractor license numbers. Its Georgia home-state board lookup (verify.sos.ga.gov) returned HTTP 403 to automated access.
